facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-9501 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-9501, M-9501 and PT-9501 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-9501 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 2 October 2009 an incident occurred on P-9501, M-9501 and PT-9501 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
